description:
Construct the Euler line for a specific triangle in GeoGebra. 

1. Create triangle ABC with vertices A(1, 1), B(7, 2), and C(4, 6).
2. Construct the Centroid (G), Circumcenter (O), and Orthocenter (H) of the triangle using geometric construction tools (Midpoint, Perpendicular Bisector, Perpendicular Line, etc.).
3. Construct the Euler line passing through these three centers.
4. Add a text annotation describing the line or identifying the centers.
5. Save your work as 'euler_line.ggb' in ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/.

Note: The Centroid, Circumcenter, and Orthocenter must be constructed geometrically, not just placed by estimating coordinates.
